proposed_workflow_requirements: OOXML scalar patchers insert newly created cells in ascending numeric column order, preserving original cell nodes and rejecting duplicate coordinates.

Do not substitute a sparse fast reader for the authoritative workbooks.read_book acceptance check. In a fresh unpatched process require canonical reader == independent reader for every table, then validate actual/stored input and result hashes.

A serialization-only repair preserves every original XML cell node/value and all other package parts; retain explicit previous release identity and before/after proof. Reuse unchanged numerical results only after complete table equivalence is authenticated.
Run the read-only all-region ordering applicability scan before integration. Keep physical relocation hashes current when a linked workbook serialization changes.
implemented_scope: Only five explicitly reassigned regional workbooks, their necessary identity/proof metadata, and owned ignored scratch.
